name: work_example
description: A released work composition for one account profile. It appears only with the posts of the profile site that explicitly releases it. The headline describes the work; made_with identifies material used and does not establish a client endorsement, delivery, availability, or account ownership. program_template names the published reusable ProgramFabric template a visitor may start in their own account; it is not a program anyone runs, and starting it copies nothing from this profile. facts carries the short labelled details; there is no separate terms field.
